a.lede: Khosla-backed Mazama Energy has developed a new way to supercool its geothermal drill bits, letting it drill faster and deeper in a quest to bring down the cost of electricity.
a.title: Mazama Energy has a solution for geothermal’s biggest drilling problem

b.lede: Geothermal heat pumps could free up significant space on the grid. Bedrock Energy raised $24 million to bring its AI-guided drill rigs to more markets.
b.title: Bedrock Energy raises $24M to build more AI-enabled geothermal drill rigs for enterprise buildings
